d:
Lokaaastha ka mahaparv chhath ab hamari arthavyavastha se bhi jurta ja raha hai. yah parv chhote karobariyon ke lie vardan sabit ho raha hai. sal 2025 men 10 karor se adhik logon ne pure desh men chhath parv manaya tha. 'da kanphedreshan oph ol indiya tredars' yani CAIT ke aankron ke anusar 2025 men desh bhar men 50000 karor se adhik ka karobar chhath ke dauran kiya gaya, jismen bihar ka hissa 15000 karor se adhik tha.
